name: TelOne Bulawayo Data Centre
notes: TelOne (state-owned telco) opened its first Matabeleland data centre at its Main Exchange in Bulawayo (Cnr Main Street & Leopold Takawira Street) in April 2022; Tier 3 designed facility with 120 racks and 400 kVA (~0.4 MW) total power, part of a US$4m+ investment since 2016. Capacity approximated from 400 kVA.

name: TelOne Harare Data Centre (107 Union Avenue)
notes: TelOne's main Harare data centre at 107 Union Avenue, CBD, described as a Tier 3 design facility offering colocation, VPS, storage and DR-as-a-service; 263Chat reported it as Zimbabwe's flagship data storage/processing facility. Public MW capacity not found. Herald reported in June 2026 that TelOne runs three data centres with ~1 MW combined power and is pursuing a US$250m transformation strategy to expand capacity.

name: Africa Data Centres Harare (ADC Harare)
notes: Africa Data Centres, the Cassava Technologies data centre operator, lists Harare among its four operating markets (Johannesburg, Nairobi, Cape Town, Harare); Baxtel and Inflect list ADC Harare as a fully operational facility in Harare. No public MW capacity found; ADC Harare presence is related to Econet's 5 MW build (see Econet entry).

name: Econet Wireless 5MW data centre Harare
developer: Econet Wireless Zimbabwe (with Africa Data Centres)
notes: Econet Wireless Zimbabwe commissioned a 5 MW data centre in Harare developed in collaboration with Africa Data Centres; corporate client onboarding began end-June 2025. CEO Douglas Mboweni stated the facility guarantees 100% power availability and Econet plans to double capacity to 10 MW in the near term for AI-driven demand.

name: Utande Internet Services data centre
notes: Data center directories list an Utande Internet Services facility at Level 9, Pegasus House, 54 Samora Machel Avenue, Harare; Utande is the ISP trading division of Dandemutande Investments, one of Zimbabwe's main licensed internet access providers. No public MW capacity or commissioning date found.

name: Dandemutande Tier 3 carrier-neutral data centre
notes: ISP Dandemutande committed in February 2025 (ITU Partner2Connect programme) to build a USD 15 million Tier 3, carrier-neutral data centre in Zimbabwe, targeting SMEs, content providers, financial institutions, government and healthcare; commitment target completion 1 June 2026. Exact site not disclosed in public reports; Dandemutande is Harare-headquartered.

name: Centre Africa Data Centre, Harare
notes: DataCenterJournal directory lists 'Centre Africa Data Centre, Harare' as a Harare facility (page last updated Dec 2024) but does not identify the operating company; no other public details on capacity or status found, so this is recorded on directory evidence only.

name: Cloudflare Harare data centre (edge PoP)
notes: Cloudflare welcomed Harare, Zimbabwe to its global network in mid-2022 (announced with 18 new cities across 10 countries), deploying an edge data centre/point of presence hosted with an unnamed local partner (believed Liquid Intelligent Technologies); Zimpricecheck reported local caching benefits in August 2022. This is edge PoP infrastructure rather than a wholesale colocation campus.

name: Zimbabwe Government National Data Centre
developer: Government of Zimbabwe (Ministry of ICT / Office of the President and Cabinet)
notes: The national data centre at the Mukwati government complex in Harare was officially commissioned on 24 February 2021 by President Mnangagwa; it is a centralised e-government facility for data processing/storage across ministries, anchored to the National Development Strategy and Vision 2030. No public MW capacity found.
Targeted searches for Manicaland/Mutare with data center/datacenter/server farm/hyperscale terms found no verified public physical data-center facility or project in the province.

name: TelOne Mazowe Data Centre (Mazowe Earth Station)
notes: TelOne opened its fourth data centre at the Mazowe Earth Station (Zimbabwe's main satellite earth receiving station, Mazowe district north of Harare) in March 2022 - 34 racks across 1,300 sqm with Tier III design; expansion projects were later commissioned (Business Times coverage; 263Chat reported a US$1 million extension commissioned April 2026; earlier US$4-5m expansion reported by NewZimbabwe/Zimbabwe Situation). Mazowe district is administratively in Mashonaland Central province, though some directories file it under Harare.
